sheep_303_fix_round.p1_runtime_expiry_driver: Main-owned injectable scheduler started only when the switch is enabled; the tick drives poll(now); stop() cancels it and blocks further aggregation; default OFF starts no timer

duplicates never reached the aggregation layer through the real wiring; both receipt statuses are now delivered so duplicates are dropped and counted there
sheep_303_fix_round.ordering_contract: source_message_ids are the CANONICAL row ids from the receipt (durable primary keys); ordering is observedAt (primary) then receipt arrival order (secondary), never a derived id
known_limits: window/process-scoped dedupe only: no cross-restart exactly-once guarantee
